content_sections.heading: NABFINS Customer Service Officer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: NABFINS has announced vacancies for the post of Customer Service Officer (CSO). The selected candidates will work in field operations and assist the branch in customer sourcing, portfolio development and collection activities. The exact number of vacancies has not been mentioned in the recruitment details.

content_sections.heading: NABFINS Customer Service Officer Important Dates 2026
NABFINS Customer Service Officer Job Responsibilities
content_sections.text: The primary role of a Customer Service Officer is to increase customer base and build a sustainable portfolio for the branch. The major responsibilities include: Identifying new business locations. Sourcing and adding potential customers. Supporting customer onboarding activities. Assisting in field-level operations. Collecting customer installments on scheduled dates. Maintaining customer relationships.

content_sections.heading: NABFINS Customer Service Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the NABFINS Customer Service Officer Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the required educational qualification and field operation requirements. The minimum educational qualification required is: PUC/10+2 Completed. Candidates who have completed higher secondary education or equivalent qualification can apply. Freshers are eligible to apply. Candidates having 1-3 years of experience in a similar job profile with exposure to field operations and customer handling will be preferred. Candidates must have written, spoken and reading knowledge of the local language and English. A valid driving licence and motorcycle are mandatory for this post as the role involves regular field visits and customer interaction.

content_sections.heading: NABFINS Customer Service Officer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates may be shortlisted based on their qualification, experience, field suitability and other requirements. Further selection details will be communicated to shortlisted applicants.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NABFINS Customer Service Officer Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply for the NABFINS Customer Service Officer Recruitment 2026 by submitting their resume through the official application process. Visit the official NABFINS careers page. Download the application form if required. Fill in the required details correctly. Prepare an updated resume. Send the resume/application form to [email protected]. Complete the application process as per the instructions.

content_sections.heading: General Instructions
content_sections.text: Decision of the NABFINS in all matters regarding eligibility of the candidate, the stages at which such scrutiny of eligibility is to be undertaken, the documents to be produced at the time of selection etc. and any other matter relating to recruitment will be final and binding on the candidates. No correspondence or personal enquiries shall be entertained by the Nabfins in this regard. Nabfins reserves the right to reject any application/ candidature at any stage without assigning any reason and the decision of the Nabfins shall be final. For any clarifications candidates may contact at [email protected] or at 080 26970500. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
